<thought>We need to determine the number of methyl groups in the unknown molecule. The available tools can provide NMR data for the sample. The carbon NMR spectrum will show signals for carbon atoms; methyl carbons typically appear in the low-field region (~10‑30 ppm). By counting distinct carbon signals in that region we can infer the number of methyl groups. I will first retrieve the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
